Talent0_2Ability.name: Helmsman
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking with a Rocket Launcher, for each target hit, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=4010500>[Intel]</buf>. Can stack up to <color=#F74848>25</color> times. Rocket Launcher Weight: <color=#F74848>-130</color>.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Helmsman
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When actively attacking with a Rocket Launcher, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=4010500>[Intel]</buf> for each target hit. Can stack up to <color=#F74848>25</color> times. Rocket Launcher Weight: <color=#F74848>-130</color>.
When deployed, gains <color=#F74848>10</color> stacks of <buf ID=4010500>[Intel]</buf>.

400001.name: Strategic Bombing 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a Tactical Weapon runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

700024.name: Graphite Warhead
700024.describe: Uses a Rocket Launcher to attack all targets within a <range type=1>3x3-tile area</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.25x</color> AoE DMG. Inflicts <buf ID=3006502>[Short Circuit I]</buf> on targets hit. Can trigger only <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

401002.name: Know Your Enemy
401002.SpecificEffects: At start of action, if <buf ID=4010500>[Intel]</buf> stacks are less than or equal to <color=#F74848>10</color>, they will not decrease.

401003.name: Battle Planning
401003.describe: Fully reloads all Rocket Launcher Ammo and gains <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=4010500>[Intel]</buf>. Can continue action with remaining Movement.

401004.name: Tactical Command
401004.describe: Can choose <color=#F74848>1</color> skill to execute. After use, switches to <skill ID=4010041>[All-Out Assault Tactics]</skill>, <skill ID=4010042>[Maneuverability Tactics]</skill>, or <skill ID=4010043>[Total Offensive Tactics]</skill>.

401005.name: Enhanced Warhead
401005.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Rocket Launcher, after combat, grants <color=#F74848>1</color> random buff to allies within attack range. Lasts for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

401006.name: Wide-Range Bombing
401006.describe: Consumes <color=#F74848>2</color> Ammo. Uses a Rocket Launcher to attack all targets within a <range type=1>5x5-tile area</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.25x</color> AoE DMG to all parts. After combat, grants all allies <color=#F74848>1</color> random buff effect, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

401007.name: Intelligence Advantage
401007.SpecificEffects: When at <color=#F74848>20</color> or more <buf ID=4010500>[Intel]</buf> stacks, allies take <color=#F74848>15%</color> less DMG from active AoE attacks, and gain <color=#F74848>1</color> random buff after combat for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

401008.name: Fire Support Bombing
401008.describe: Simultaneously uses two Rocket Launchers to attack all targets within the selected <range type=1>5x5-tile area</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.15x</color> AoE DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times. For each target hit, grants all allies <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=4010082>[Ambush Tactics]</buf> after combat, stackable up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times. A single attack can grant up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks.

400031.name: Indiscriminate 1
400031.SpecificEffects: After the first attack with a Tactical Weapon each turn, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, with Final DMG <color=#F74848>-30%</color>, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

400033.name: Strategic Bombing 4
400033.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf> is complete, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400034.name: Indiscriminate 2
400034.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon for the first time each turn, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP cost, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400035.name: Indiscriminate 3
400035.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> is triggered, allow continued moving with the remaining movement.

400036.name: Indiscriminate 4
400036.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, it no longer reduces final damage.

401041.name: Flawless Strategy 1
401041.SpecificEffects: When deployed, gains an additional <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks of <buf ID=4010500>[Intel]</buf>.

400043.name: Power Innovation 3
400043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401044.name: Flawless Strategy 2
401044.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=4010500>[Intel]</buf> effect increased to boost all allies' DMG by <color=#F74848>1.2%</color>. Removes <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks at start of action.

401045.name: Flawless Strategy 3
401045.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=4010500>[Intel]</buf> is at <color=#F74848>20</color> or more stacks, AP Regen <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

401046.name: Flawless Strategy 4
401046.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=4010500>[Intel]</buf> cap increased to <color=#F74848>35</color> stacks, and <buf ID=4010500>[Intel]</buf> effect on this unit increases by <color=#F74848>75%</color>.
